title: Crab Derby, 2008 · after
logline: The Monday after: the Newport weekly on Gully's counter, open to the classifieds, the crab flyer among the boat listings and the lost cats. Gully pins the page to his corkboard beside the 2003 rough. The board's second thing from Wood's hand.

panels.composition: Gully's. The weekly open on the counter to the classifieds; the crab flyer among the ads. GULLY. WOOD on the stool.
